name: Carpenter Co
old_description: Carpenter Co. is the world’s largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, and serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production locations.
about:
Carpenter Co. is headquartered in Moore, Oklahoma, and traces its origins to 1950 when it began as a local latex foam manufacturer. The company has since grown into the world's largest vertically integrated producer of polyurethane foam and specialty polymer products, though ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

Today, Carpenter operates more than 60 production locations worldwide and employs over 6,500 people. Its core manufacturing includes polyurethane foams, polyether polyols (a key component in flexible urethane foams), polyester fibers, and insulation materials. The company maintains state-of-the-art research and development facilities in Richmond and other sites, where expert teams design innovative products and conduct rigorous in-house testing. Recent innovations include the patent-pending Casper Core+ technology aimed at improving mattress recyclability.

Carpenter serves a diversified global marketplace, with noted customers in the medical field (where it provides tailored protection products), mattress manufacturing, transportation (including a dedicated Carpenter Transportation team), and travel and leisure sectors. The company's domestic mattress manufacturing operations have been highlighted for supporting American jobs and local communities.

The company emphasizes its purpose, vision, mission, and values as guiding principles, alongside a code of conduct and ethics. Environmental stewardship is a stated focus, with efforts to enhance quality of life while preserving the planet. Vertical integration and a global footprint are cited as key differentiators, enabling control over the supply chain from chemical solutions to finished foam products.
